description: This file defines the TailscaleNetwork enum with methods to identify and detect IPv4 addresses associated with a Tailscale tailnet network. It includes functions to validate IPv4 addresses and retrieve a tailnet IPv4 address from network interfaces.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if the provided IPv4 address string belongs to the Tailscale tailnet range.

methods.name: detectTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Attempts to find and return a tailnet IPv4 address currently assigned to a network interface.
